name: Marching Fishes
main_effect: [Main] Choose 1 of your Digimon. Until the end of your opponent's turn, 3 of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards at that Digimon can't attack or block.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't attack for the turn. Then, add this card to your hand.
